state.seed_assertion: Network analysis should check duplicate IP addresses, marginal connectors, duplex or speed negotiation, multicast handling and excessive broadcast traffic.

sentences.1: Harmonic distortion creates electromagnetic interference that degrades high-speed communication signals in networked PLCs.
sentences.2: It gets missed because everyone assumed someone else handled it, the note lived on a clipboard nobody checked, or the reminder sat in an inbox with fifty other messages.
sentences.3: Physical stress testing on cabling and connectors, vibration testing, and thermal cycling can reveal wiring and soldering issues.
sentences.4: Physical stress on cabling and connectors as well as vibration and thermal cycling (heat gun and freeze spray) can often chase out wiring and soldering issues.
